title: New website is live
paragraphs: This site has had a full refresh — real content throughout, a proper social sharing card, and a new home at datamungingwithperl.com.
If you spot anything that still looks like leftover template text, let us know.

title: Work-in-progress edition now on Leanpub
paragraphs: The second edition is now available to read as it's being written, at roughly 65% complete.
Buying the work-in-progress edition gets you free updates as new chapters land, right through to the finished book.

title: Chapter 10 rewritten: JSON, YAML and XML
paragraphs: Chapter 10 has been retitled "Common Data Interchange Formats" and rebuilt around the three formats you'll actually meet in the wild: JSON, YAML and XML.
New sections cover JSON::MaybeXS and YAML::PP with a live weather-API example, alongside a modernized XML::LibXML treatment that replaces the old XML::Parser/XML::DOM material.
